title: Speech decoder neural dependence under drift
disposition_reason: The delivered seven-arm frozen programme and token scorer measure a genuine neural sequence target. Source-only full45 composition and generated grading controls do not establish authentic data execution, decoder competence, biological drift or direct interpretation.

scientific_target.question: Within T15 later sessions, how do fixed permitted calibration and declared feature/time corruptions change held-query phoneme error, relative to an independently frozen neural reference and no-neural prior?
scientific_target.known_answer: Source phoneme sequences for every retained later-session suffix query and the paired seven-arm session PER contrasts, with reference minus candidate full-adapt PER separate from within-candidate ablations.
scientific_target.answer_origin: The 86 public labeled train/validation HDF5 members across 45 T15 sessions; private gold after complete source projection and global repeated-sentence grouping.
scientific_target.case_unit: One full 512-feature trial time series per isolated neural inference; a session/arm context collects every suffix trial.
scientific_target.independent_unit: One person T15, with nine later-session paired summaries; arms and trials are repeated observations.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Public retrospective calibration benefit and corruption sensitivity in one participant. Feature/time corruption demonstrates input dependence, not isolated physiological channel loss or causal biological drift.
exclusions: Paper WER/CER or official-test/SOTA claims from local no-LM token PER
Feature-column zeroing identified as physical electrode loss without electrode mapping
Programme performance as direct no-tools or viewer interpretation

inputs: Complete source-defined 512-feature, 20 ms-step trial arrays in frozen order.
27 training and nine development sessions; at most the first 20 chronologically available later-session labeled trials before sentence grouping form calibration candidates.
Infer receives one opaque query and a sealed allowed model; prior receives training/current calibration token sequences only.
forbidden_inputs: Suffix-query tokens, query-time fitting of normalization or hyperparameters
Query IDs/features during adaptation, private arm names or permutation indices in participant inputs
Mutable query state carried between fresh inference processes
Replacing excluded calibration prefix trials to refill a 20-example budget
observation_contract.case_identity: Source private identity is session/block_num/trial_num; opaque identities are HMAC-derived. Every later session has seven complete arm contexts; authentic retained Q remains unresolved.
observation_contract.split: Full chronological45 roster:27 train/9 development/9 later. Global sentence priority is query then calibration then development then training; all suffix queries survive and excluded prefix trials are not replaced. Every required session/partition must retain support.
observation_contract.coverage: 86 labeled members, 63 session/arm contexts per panel and two independent panels; 38 sealed models and 56+12Q phases. The generated Q=9 fixture is not an authentic trial census.

primary.name: adapted_full_session_macro_PER
primary.aggregation: Sum token edit distances/reference tokens within each of nine later sessions, then equal-session average; literal | remains in edits and denominator and ratios are not clipped.
primary.rationale: Retains actual withheld sequence accuracy; independent reference-minus-candidate PER is an additional comparison, not a claim of author-baseline parity.

secondary: All seven absolute arm PERs and paired adaptation/corruption contrasts
Per-session edits/denominators and exact complete query coverage
Phase cost, label exposure and model lineage; optimizer-step count may be unobserved rather than fabricated zero

comparators.name: Independent compact GRU/CTC reference
comparators.procedure: Delivered fixed seed14014 compact two-layer128-unit GRU source, ten training epochs and input-layer-only 100-step calibration; not the author deployed or competition checkpoint, competence unqualified.

comparators.name: Frozen base versus adapted model
comparators.inputs: Same queries, same base initialization, declared calibration prefix
comparators.procedure: Delivered full-feature and fixed-feature-loss paired arms; fixed arms never access calibration labels.

comparators.name: Shuffle/zero and no-neural prior
comparators.inputs: Same sealed full-adapt model; duration preserved for corruption, only allowed tokens for prior
comparators.procedure: Delivered row-shuffle/raw-zero and unconditional sequence-mode prior; these do not eliminate duration information from neural arms.

nuisance_controls: Global sentence grouping prevents repeated-text memorization across labeled and query partitions.
Reuse exactly the same adapted artifact for full/shuffle/zero so refitting noise cannot masquerade as content dependence.
Time shuffle preserves multivariate rows/duration; raw zeros before model normalization can retain an identifiable treatment.
Physical electrode map and author preprocessing exposure remain unresolved; feature loss is a declared computational corruption.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source reports descriptive nine-session contrasts and no p-values/confidence intervals. Sessions are repeated measures in one person; any later uncertainty protocol must preserve this scope and serial dependence.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require every retained suffix query across all nine sessions and seven arms in both panels before private scoring. Empty token predictions are valid; invalid IDs/vocabulary or unsupported complexity remain failed/null results, never a clipped favorable PER.

implementation.scorer_target: science.score computes genuine reference-token edit rates, all seven arm means and descriptive contrasts. completed-collection-grading joins a complete producer collection to that protected score; generated fixtures only exercise composition.
implementation.delivered_scope: Frozen-program source, sealed-model/phase design, an independent compact reference, and a guarded completed-collection grader; no authentic fit, array execution or model outcome.
missing: Authenticate full45/86-member data, exact source permutations, sentence grouping and retained Q.
Reconcile published trial totals and feature/electrode provenance.
Qualify complete runtime resource envelope and observed source/model closure.
Execute and assess fixed reference competence before interpreting candidate advantage.
implementation.execution_evidence: Documentation records generated composition and relocation checks, explicitly no authentic array, target, model, Docker or new solver run.

direct_observation.representation: No no-tools phoneme interpretation condition is supplied. A new direct condition must declare how calibration observations fit the context and use the same withheld token target.
direct_observation.boundary: Only the declared observation/demonstration context, no external tools or evaluator feedback; a new direct condition needs an independently frozen view and complete output identity.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

typed_viewer.representation: No typed viewer is supplied; inspecting feature plots is not equivalent to the implemented full-array GRU/CTC observation condition.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

tool_assisted.representation: Exploratory case-adaptive agent orchestration lies outside the delivered frozen programme; tools/checkpoints and calibration access need a separate matched condition.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same permitted observations, frozen checkpoint tools and accounted compute as the compared arm; case state and feedback policy must be fixed before query.
missing: No delivered participant condition establishes this mode for the same scientific target.

frozen_program.representation: Delivered fit/adapt/infer/prior ABI, one immutable candidate source and independent reference with fresh query processes; source design is not observed isolation qualification.
frozen_program.boundary: Freeze code and fitting/adaptation recipe before queries; admit only explicitly allowed labels/calibration, retain all failed/incomplete cases.
